import pixeltable as pxt

pxt.create_dir("demo")

t = pxt.create_table(
    "demo.films",
    schema={
        "title": pxt.String,
        "year": pxt.Int,
        "revenue": pxt.Float,
    },
)

t.insert(
    [
        {"title": "Jaws", "year": 1975, "revenue": 470.7},
        {"title": "Alien", "year": 1979, "revenue": 184.7},
    ]
)
